name: claude-workflows
description: Workflow and discipline skills for Claude Code: crisp (concise output), karpathy (coding discipline), handoff (session handoff notes), doc-coauthoring (structured documentation), technical-writing (ISO 24495 + Google Technical Writing rules for drafting/reviewing docs), dotnet-xml-docs (C#/VB.NET XML doc comment conventions merged with technical-writing principles), and code-comments (inline code comment rules — English-only, no refactor/session narration, when to comment at all). Includes the /export-md command to export the current session to markdown via cc2md (run /install-tools once to provision cc2md).
